summary: Architectural implementation plan to eliminate lag, camera jitter, visual flickering, and abrupt LOD transitions across all astronomical scales in Our Visible Universe. Covers Phase A through Phase E: in-app developer performance profiler with P95/P99 latency, camera-relative 64-bit floating origin, continuous screen-space LOD with hysteresis and cross-fading, spatial particle chunking and bounded GPU vertex streaming, and strict retention of existing Lovable authentication and security flows.
